content:
We should at some point talk about supply chain security. I have a gut feeling this needs us moving much of the container business into a separate repo with processes, tests and so on.

Also, TIL about https://www.docker.com/blog/docker-oidc-connections-for-github-actions-available-for-docker-orgs/ That will allow us to get rid of a PAT in the action to ship images.
Everything old is new again. Your first container effort was in a separate repo. :smile:
Yeah. But the world has moved on since then. And we learned a lot!

This does sound good:

"TL;DR: Docker now supports OpenID Connect (OIDC) for GitHub Actions. Your workflows can authenticate with short-lived, per-run tokens instead of stored PATs or OATs. No secrets to rotate, no credentials to leak."
